title: Brazilian-Style Grilled Chicken Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish from Brazil, featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, combine olive oil, oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
3. Place chicken breast in a large bowl and pour the marinade over it. Toss to coat.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
5. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
8. Sprinkle toasted pecans over the top of the skewers before serving.
